images.question_text: Write the number represented by 3 tens and 6 ones. Choices: A) 36 | B) 63 | C) 30 Answer with the letter only.
Write 5 tens and 2 ones as a number. Choices: A) 25 | B) 52 | C) 502 Answer with the letter only.
A plane slices a cylinder parallel to its base. What is the cross-section Choices: A) Rectangle | B) Circle | C) Triangle | D) Ellipse Answer with the letter only.
Rotating a right triangle about one of its legs produces which solid Choices: A) Cylinder | B) Cone | C) Sphere | D) Pyramid Answer with the letter only.
A cone and a cylinder have the same radius and height. The cylinder's volume is 90. What is the cone's volume Choices: A) 30 | B) 45 | C) 90 | D) 270 Answer with the letter only.
A circle has radius 6. What is the length of an arc with a central angle of 60 degrees (use pi = 3.14) Choices: A) 3.14 | B) 6.28 | C) 12.56 | D) 37.68 Answer with the letter only.
A circle has radius 10. What is the area of a sector with a central angle of 90 degrees (use pi = 3.14) Choices: A) 15.7 | B) 78.5 | C) 157 | D) 314 Answer with the letter only.
An inscribed angle intercepts an arc of 100 degrees. What is the measure of the inscribed angle Choices: A) 50 degrees | B) 100 degrees | C) 200 degrees | D) 80 degrees Answer with the letter only.
In a quadrilateral inscribed in a circle, one angle is 70 degrees. What is the opposite angle Choices: A) 70 degrees | B) 20 degrees | C) 110 degrees | D) 290 degrees Answer with the letter only.
A tangent line meets a radius at the point of tangency at what angle Choices: A) 45 degrees | B) 60 degrees | C) 90 degrees | D) 180 degrees Answer with the letter only.

Two tangent segments are drawn to a circle from the same external point. One is 9 cm. What is the other Choices: A) 4.5 cm | B) 9 cm | C) 18 cm | D) It cannot be determined Answer with the letter only.
A chord is 8 cm long and 3 cm from the center of a circle. What is the radius Choices: A) 4 cm | B) 5 cm | C) 7 cm | D) 11 cm Answer with the letter only.
A parabola has focus (0, 2) and directrix y = -2. What is its equation Choices: A) y = (1/8)x^2 | B) y = (1/4)x^2 | C) y = 8x^2 | D) x = (1/8)y^2 Answer with the letter only.
A parabola has focus (0, -1) and directrix y = 1. Which way does it open Choices: A) Up | B) Down | C) Left | D) Right Answer with the letter only.
What is the vertex of the parabola with focus (3, 5) and directrix y = 1 Choices: A) (3, 3) | B) (3, 5) | C) (3, 1) | D) (0, 3) Answer with the letter only.
Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. AB = 6, DE = 9, BC = 8. What is EF Choices: A) 10 | B) 11 | C) 12 | D) 13.5 Answer with the letter only.
A 6-foot person casts a 4-foot shadow. A nearby tree casts a 30-foot shadow. How tall is the tree Choices: A) 20 ft | B) 36 ft | C) 45 ft | D) 60 ft Answer with the letter only.
In triangle ABC, an angle bisector from A meets BC at D. If AB = 8, AC = 12, and BD = 4, what is DC Choices: A) 4 | B) 6 | C) 8 | D) 12 Answer with the letter only.

A line parallel to one side of a triangle intersects the other two sides. It divides those sides Choices: A) Into equal parts | B) Proportionally | C) Into perpendicular segments | D) Into parts that sum to the third side Answer with the letter only.

The midsegment of a triangle connects the midpoints of two sides. How does it compare to the third side Choices: A) It is parallel and half as long | B) It is perpendicular and half as long | C) It is parallel and equal in length | D) It is parallel and twice as long Answer with the letter only.

A ladder leans against a wall making a 60 degree angle with the ground. The ladder is 12 feet long. How high up the wall does it reach Choices: A) 6 ft | B) 6 times the square root of 3 ft, about 10.4 ft | C) 12 times the square root of 3 ft | D) 24 ft Answer with the letter only.
A regular hexagon has side length 8. What is the length of its apothem Choices: A) 4 | B) 8 | C) 4 times the square root of 3 | D) 8 times the square root of 3 Answer with the letter only.

A ramp rises 3 feet over a horizontal distance of 12 feet. Which expression gives the angle of elevation Choices: A) tan^-1(3/12) | B) sin^-1(3/12) | C) cos^-1(3/12) | D) tan^-1(12/3) Answer with the letter only.
Scores are normally distributed with mean 70 and standard deviation 5. What percent of scores fall between 65 and 75 Choices: A) 68% | B) 95% | C) 99.7% | D) 50% Answer with the letter only.
With mean 70 and standard deviation 5, what percent of scores are above 80 Choices: A) 2.5% | B) 5% | C) 16% | D) 34% Answer with the letter only.

Two normal curves have the same mean but different standard deviations. The curve with the larger standard deviation is Choices: A) Wider and flatter | B) Taller and narrower | C) Shifted to the right | D) Shifted to the left Answer with the letter only.

The zero x = 2 of p(x) = (x - 2)^2 (x + 1) has multiplicity 2. How does the graph behave at x = 2 Choices: A) It crosses the x-axis | B) It touches the x-axis and turns around | C) It has a vertical asymptote | D) It has a hole Answer with the letter only.

A polynomial graph falls on both ends. Which is possible Choices: A) Degree 3, positive leading coefficient | B) Degree 4, negative leading coefficient | C) Degree 4, positive leading coefficient | D) Degree 5, negative leading coefficient Answer with the letter only.
In triangle ABC, angle A = 30 degrees, angle B = 45 degrees, and a = 10. Use the law of sines to find b (round to one decimal) Choices: A) 14.1 | B) 7.1 | C) 20 | D) 12.2 Answer with the letter only.
In triangle ABC, a = 5, b = 7, and angle C = 60 degrees. Use the law of cosines to find c (round to one decimal) Choices: A) 6.2 | B) 8.6 | C) 3.5 | D) 10.4 Answer with the letter only.
A piecewise function is f(x) = x + 1 for x < 1 and f(x) = 3 - x for x ≥ 1. What is the limit of f(x) as x approaches 1 Choices: A) 2 | B) 1 | C) 3 | D) Does not exist Answer with the letter only.
What is the limit of 1 / (x - 3) as x approaches 3 from the right Choices: A) Positive infinity | B) Negative infinity | C) 0 | D) 3 Answer with the letter only.
The function f(x) = (x^2 - 9) / (x - 3) has which type of discontinuity at x = 3 Choices: A) Removable (a hole) | B) Jump | C) Infinite | D) It is continuous at x = 3 Answer with the letter only.
In triangle ABC, a = 8, b = 6, and angle C = 90 degrees. Using the law of cosines, what is c Choices: A) 10 | B) 14 | C) 2 | D) 100 Answer with the letter only.

In triangle ABC, angle A = 40 degrees, angle B = 60 degrees, and a = 12. Use the law of sines to find b (round to one decimal) Choices: A) 16.2 | B) 8.9 | C) 18.0 | D) 10.4 Answer with the letter only.

Write 1 + i in polar form Choices: A) The square root of 2 times (cos(pi/4) + i sin(pi/4)) | B) 2(cos(pi/4) + i sin(pi/4)) | C) The square root of 2 times (cos(pi/2) + i sin(pi/2)) | D) 1(cos(pi/4) + i sin(pi/4)) Answer with the letter only.

Write 2(cos(pi/3) + i sin(pi/3)) in rectangular form Choices: A) 1 + i times the square root of 3 | B) The square root of 3 plus i | C) 2 + 2i | D) 1 - i times the square root of 3 Answer with the letter only.
What is the argument (angle) of the complex number -1 + i, measured from the positive real axis Choices: A) 3pi/4 | B) pi/4 | C) -pi/4 | D) 5pi/4 Answer with the letter only.

A vector has magnitude 10 and direction angle 60 degrees. What are its components Choices: A) <5, 5 times the square root of 3> | B) <5 times the square root of 3, 5> | C) <10, 60> | D) <5, 5> Answer with the letter only.
What is the direction angle of the vector <-1, the square root of 3> Choices: A) 120 degrees | B) 60 degrees | C) -60 degrees | D) 150 degrees Answer with the letter only.
A boat heads east at 12 mph while the current pushes it north at 5 mph. What is the boat's resultant speed Choices: A) 13 mph | B) 17 mph | C) 7 mph | D) 60 mph Answer with the letter only.

Which angle is larger? Choices: A) An angle measuring 45 degrees | B) An angle measuring 90 degrees | C) An angle measuring 30 degrees | D) An angle measuring 120 degrees Answer with the letter only.

A triangle has side lengths of 6 cm, 8 cm, and 10 cm, and one right angle. How is the triangle classified? Choices: A) Right isosceles triangle | B) Acute scalene triangle | C) Obtuse equilateral triangle | D) Right scalene triangle Answer with the letter only.
Which name refers to the same angle as ∠POQ? Choices: A) ∠OPQ | B) ∠P | C) ∠OQP | D) ∠QOP Answer with the letter only.
Which shape has at least one line of symmetry? Choices: A) Scalene triangle | B) Irregular pentagon | C) Trapezoid with no equal sides | D) Equilateral triangle Answer with the letter only.

Two lines intersect creating four angles. If one angle measures 130 degrees, which angle is also obtuse? Choices: A) The adjacent acute angle | B) Any angle | C) The smallest angle | D) The vertical opposite angle Answer with the letter only.

A skier wants to launch off a ramp at an angle of 42° from the ground. The ramp he has is 18°. He will add a second ramp on top to make 42°. What angle should the second ramp be? Choices: A) 20° | B) 24° | C) 30° | D) 60° Answer with the letter only.

Angle y is a straight angle. It is made of three parts: 95°, x°, and 25°. Which equation finds x? Choices: A) 90 - 95 - 25 = x | B) 180 - 95 - 25 = x | C) 180 + 95 + 25 = x | D) 90 + 95 + 25 = x Answer with the letter only.
A protractor reading shows one ray at 35° and the other at 80°. What is the measure of the angle? Choices: A) 35° | B) 45° | C) 80° | D) 115° Answer with the letter only.
An area model breaks 24 × 32 into 20 × 30, 20 × 2, 4 × 30, and 4 × 2. What is the total area? Choices: A) 720 | B) 748 | C) 768 | D) 784 Answer with the letter only.
An area model breaks 53 × 62 into 50 × 60, 50 × 2, 3 × 60, and 3 × 2. What is the total area? Choices: A) 3,180 | B) 3,206 | C) 3,286 | D) 3,360 Answer with the letter only.

A square table seats 4 people. When 2 tables are joined along a side, 6 people can be seated. If 4 tables are joined in a row, how many people can be seated? Choices: A) 8 | B) 10 | C) 12 | D) 14 Answer with the letter only.

On a number line, a frog jumps forward by $ \frac{3}{4} $ three times, starting at 0 and landing on $ \frac{9}{4} $. Which expression matches the jumps? Choices: A) $ \frac{3}{4} + \frac{3}{4} + \frac{3}{4} $ | B) $ \frac{3}{4} + \frac{4}{3} $ | C) $ 3 \times \frac{1}{4} $ | D) $ \frac{3}{4} \times 4 $ Answer with the letter only.

Five equal-sized strips each have $ \frac{1}{6} $ of the strip shaded. What is the total shaded amount? Choices: A) $ \frac{5}{6} $ | B) $ \frac{5}{12} $ | C) $ \frac{1}{6} $ | D) $ \frac{6}{5} $ Answer with the letter only.

On a number line, a robot moves forward by $ \frac{1}{5} $ five times, starting at 0 and landing on $ \frac{5}{5} $. Which expression matches the moves? Choices: A) $ \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{5} + \frac{1}{5} $ | B) $ 5 \times \frac{1}{4} $ | C) $ \frac{1}{5} \times 4 $ | D) $ \frac{1}{5} \times \frac{1}{5} $ Answer with the letter only.

A zoo enclosure is made by joining two rectangular tanks. The first tank measures 5 m by 4 m by 3 m. The second tank measures 6 m by 5 m by 2 m. What is the total volume of the enclosure in cubic meters Choices: A) 120 | B) 150 | C) 170 | D) 180 Answer with the letter only.

A solid is built using unit cubes. The figure has 2 identical layers, and each layer contains 16 cubes. What is the total volume of the figure in cubic units Choices: A) 16 | B) 24 | C) 32 | D) 48 Answer with the letter only.

A shape is made from two rectangular prisms. Prism A measures 8 in by 5 in by 4 in. Prism B measures 6 in by 5 in by 4 in. What is the total volume of the shape Choices: A) 240 | B) 260 | C) 280 | D) 300 Answer with the letter only.
A solid figure is made of 3 layers. Each layer contains 9 unit cubes. What is the volume of the figure in cubic units Choices: A) 18 | B) 21 | C) 27 | D) 36 Answer with the letter only.
A solid has 2 layers. Each layer contains 11 unit cubes. What is the volume of the solid in cubic units Choices: A) 11 | B) 20 | C) 22 | D) 24 Answer with the letter only.

A figure is made of two rectangular prisms. One prism measures 3 in by 4 in by 6 in. The other prism measures 5 in by 4 in by 6 in. What is the total volume of the figure Choices: A) 168 | B) 180 | C) 192 | D) 204 Answer with the letter only.
What is the distance between the points (2, 4) and (8, 4) Choices: A) 4 | B) 6 | C) 8 | D) 10 Answer with the letter only.
A point is located at (1, 5). Which point is 4 units directly below it Choices: A) (1,1) | B) (5,1) | C) (1,9) | D) (4,5) Answer with the letter only.
Point A is at (3, 2). Point B is at (3, 9). What is the distance between A and B Choices: A) 7 | B) 6 | C) 9 | D) 5 Answer with the letter only.

Classify a triangle with side lengths 7 cm, 9 cm, and 12 cm by its side lengths. Choices: A) Isosceles triangle | B) Equilateral triangle | C) Scalene triangle Answer with the letter only.
A triangle has one angle that measures 90°. How is this triangle classified by its angles Choices: A) Acute triangle | B) Obtuse triangle | C) Right triangle Answer with the letter only.
A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. What is this shape called Choices: A) Parallelogram | B) Rectangle | C) Trapezoid Answer with the letter only.

Which triangle could be both acute and isosceles Choices: A) A triangle with angles 30°, 60°, and 90° | B) A triangle with angles 100°, 40°, and 40° | C) A triangle with angles 50°, 50°, and 80° Answer with the letter only.

Each of five whole grids is divided into 100 equal squares, with 36 squares shaded in each grid. Which expression represents the total shaded amount in wholes? Choices: A) $ 36 \times 5 $ | B) $ 0.36 \times 5 $ | C) $ 0.5 \times 0.36 $ | D) $ 5 \times 36 $ Answer with the letter only.

Cassie builds a hollow square pyramid model. The base is a square with side 18 cm. Each triangular face has base 18 cm and height 22 cm. How much cardboard is needed including the bottom Choices: A) 792 | B) 1116 | C) 720 | D) 1440 Answer with the letter only.

How many edges does a triangular prism have Choices: A) 6 | B) 8 | C) 9 | D) 12 Answer with the letter only.

A tape diagram shows 18 plus x equals 31. What is x Choices: A) 49 | B) 13 | C) 31 | D) 18 Answer with the letter only.

Points on a graph include (0, 4), (3, 7), and (6, 10). Which rule matches Choices: A) y = 0.5x + 4 | B) y = x + 4 | C) y = 2x + 4 | D) y = x - 4 Answer with the letter only.
Which inequality matches: open circle at 1 with shading to the left Choices: A) x ≤ 1 | B) x > 1 | C) x ≥ 1 | D) x < 1 Answer with the letter only.
